# 8. Development {.unnumbered}

This section is for contributors who need to understand, change, test, or
deploy CAST. It reflects the current application, which uses Flask, Panel,
MySQL, MODFLOW 6, and Docker Compose.

The section contains:

1. [Architecture and Code Structure](code_structure.qmd)
2. [Technology Stack](code_libraries.qmd)
3. [Development Workflow](code_develop.qmd)

For installation instructions, begin with [Run CAST locally](../start/run_locally.qmd).
